profile_text.body:
Course Hero, founded in 2006 and headquartered in Redwood City, describes itself as offering instant access to millions of study resources, course notes, test prep, 24/7 homework help, tutors, and more. The company positions itself around helping students learn, teach, and study, framing its core value proposition as helping users "own the study hour" and "get unstuck."

The company's AI product offering includes QuillBot, a paraphrasing tool categorized under writing and editing. Course Hero operates as a business of Learneo, Inc.
